title: Dust
description: An LP cover that sat in a basement since '72, lying on a crate under a warm lamp and buried in grey dust. Drag to brush it: slow strokes wipe it clean in bristle streaks, fast flicks throw dust and lint into the light, and the gloss comes back underneath.
intent: One physical surface finished to the edge: a real soft brush on real dust, where speed decides how much you clean and every stroke throws particles up into the lamplight.
